# DevCodeHub

> A shared drop for development teams. Create a share, add images, zip files, PDFs
> or Word documents, and send the link. Free. Sign in with email or Google.

DevCodeHub was designed and built by Shams Ali Shaikh, a full stack developer
working in Next.js and React. It is his own project, maintained solo.

## Key facts

- Name: DevCodeHub
- URL: https://devcodehub.cloud
- Developer: Shams Ali Shaikh (https://github.com/dev-shamsali, https://www.linkedin.com/in/shams-ali-shaikh-27194425a/)
- Price: free, no paid tier
- Account required: yes, email and password or Google; a login lasts 45 days or until logout
- Files: images, zip archives, PDFs and Word documents, delivered through ImageKit, 25 MB per file
- Retention: unpinned shares clear after 36 hours, pinned shares persist

## Pages

- https://devcodehub.cloud/ : what DevCodeHub is, how it works, FAQ, developer bio
- https://devcodehub.cloud/media : share files with a team (requires sign-in)
